c105.title: A day at the art museum
c105.story: On Saturday, Anna takes Max to the [[art]] museum. Max likes a [[Renaissance|renaissance]] [[portrait]] of a man in a red hat. Anna likes a painting of the [[Madonna|madonna]], full of [[symbolism]]. Then she studies the [[contour]] of a face in a drawing. Statues by a famous [[sculptor]] stand on stone [[pedestals|pedestal]]. Max wants to sit on a chair, but it is an [[antique]]! Upstairs, there are modern paintings in the style of [[realism]]. "That man is a movie [[critic]] from TV," Anna whispers. "The woman next to him is an [[art critic]]." The [[curator]] shows them a big painting of Kyiv. She talks about its strong [[contrast]] of dark and light. Both critics smile, and Max takes a photo.

c106.title: Street art in Kyiv
c106.story: In an old district of Kyiv, Max shows Anna walls with [[graffiti]]. On one house, there is a huge [[mural]] of a big bird. "The city pays for this [[public art]]," Max says. The [[facade]] is gray stone, but the bird is on the side. So the [[exterior]] of the house is gray, [[indigo]] and white. Next, they go into an [[art space]] in an old factory. It shows [[contemporary art]] by young artists. One room is full of [[avant-garde]] pictures. Anna buys a poster by a local [[illustrator]]. An old teacher talks about [[design]] with a young [[designer]]. She shows him a bright [[visual]] for a concert. At home, Anna puts her new poster on the wall.

c107.title: What shall we watch?
c107.story: On Friday, Anna and Max want to watch a [[film]] at home. Max says [[streaming]] is better than the cinema. They open their [[streaming service]], but they cannot choose. They watch two [[trailers|trailer]], a short [[preview]] and a loud [[promo]]. Anna checks every [[rating]], and they argue about the [[genre]]. Anna wants a [[thriller]], but Max wants [[sci-fi]]. "What about [[fantasy]]?" Anna asks. Then Max gives a [[spoiler]] about the [[sequel]] of a summer [[blockbuster]]. Anna throws a pillow at him. "OK, a [[remake]] of an old comedy, then?" Max asks. Finally, they choose a [[spin-off]] about a funny neighbor. They both laugh all evening.

c108.title: Max's favorite TV show
c108.story: On Thursdays at [[prime time]], the family watches TV together. But everyone wants a different [[show]]. Max wants a new [[episode]] of his favorite [[sitcom]]. Grandma prefers a [[game show]] with big prizes. Taras loves a [[reality show]] about young cooks. Mom wants a [[talk show]] with a funny [[gag]] about a cat. Its next [[segment]] is about healthy food. Max sighs and says, "We need better [[entertainment]]!" Then Taras has an idea: a family [[talent show]] in the living room! Grandma sings, Mom dances, and Max tells jokes. Nobody turns on the TV all evening.

c111.title: Taras's anime and manga
c111.story: Taras watches [[anime]] every night after dinner. His favorite hero is a shy boy at school. But at night, he is strong like a [[superman]]. His only weakness is cold water, his [[kryptonite]]. The villain has many [[minions|minion]] and one [[lackey]] who carries his coat. His [[robot]] cleans, his [[droid]] beeps, and his [[android]] looks human. His best fighter is a [[cyborg]], half man and half machine. They all live in a [[creepy]] castle with an old [[vampire]]. The castle cook is not a [[cannibal]]; he only makes soup! Before bed, Taras reads a [[manga]], a long [[saga]] about a hero. He falls asleep with the book on his face.
